LanguageData.LP_MI_ReadMind.label: read mind (helm of telepathy)
LanguageData.LP_MI_ReadMind.description: Peek at the traits, best skills and mood of one person within 15 cells; also lowers some resistance on prisoners. Once per day; no cooldown when used by a mind flayer.
LanguageData.LP_MI_StoredSpell.label: release stored spell
LanguageData.LP_MI_StoredSpell.description: Release the spell stored in the ring of spell storing (same effect as the corresponding scroll). Unusable while the ring is empty.
LanguageData.LP_MI_Soothe.label: calm animal
LanguageData.LP_MI_Soothe.description: Calm one maddened (manhunting, berserk) animal within 15 cells. Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_MI_ShootingStar.label: call meteor
LanguageData.LP_MI_ShootingStar.description: Call a meteor down from the night sky onto a target point within 25 cells: an explosion of radius 2 (20 damage) that ignites the impact point. Cooldown half a day (twice per day).
LanguageData.LP_MI_FireballBead.label: throw fireball
LanguageData.LP_MI_FireballBead.description: Pluck a fireball bead and throw it at a target point within 12 cells: a fire explosion of radius 2.5 (15 damage). Uses up one bead.
LanguageData.LP_MI_PrayHeal.label: prayer of healing
LanguageData.LP_MI_PrayHeal.description: Pray holding the beads to heal the worst wound of one person within 5 cells. Once per day, sharing a cooldown with "prayer blessing". Mind flayers can't use it.
LanguageData.LP_MI_PrayBless.label: prayer blessing
LanguageData.LP_MI_PrayBless.description: Pray aloud: allies within 6 cells (including yourself) get hit +5% and mind resistance +10% for 1 hour. Once per day, sharing a cooldown with "prayer of healing". Mind flayers can't use it.
LanguageData.LP_MI_AstralStep.label: astral jump (amulet)
LanguageData.LP_MI_AstralStep.description: Pass through the Astral Plane with the astral amulet and instantly appear on an open standable spot within 8 cells. Once per day; 5% chance to be blown to the map edge.
